title: kaunsa ranj tha jo sheh se uthaya na gaya
body:
kaunsa ranj tha jo sheh se uthaya na gaya
par koi shikwa zaba'n par kabhi laaya na gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
chaaha akbar ne ke dekhe na pidar zakhme jigar
khoon is josh se ubhla ke chupaaya na gaya
kaunsa ranj tha....
<<DIVIDER>>
hogaye mitke fana khud hi mitaane waale
haa magar matame shabbir mitaaya na gaya
kaunsa ranj tha....
<<DIVIDER>>
khaali jhoola kabhi bhoole se jhula deti thi maa
jhoolna jhoole me asghar ka bhulaaya na gaya
kaunsa ranj tha....
<<DIVIDER>>
boli maa laashae akbar ki balayei'n lekar
tumko naushah mere laal banaya na gaya
kaunsa ranj tha....
<<DIVIDER>>
tukde tukde tha badan farq tha paara paara
shah se laasha-e abbas uthaya na gaya
kaunsa ranj tha....
<<DIVIDER>>
poocha jab bano ne kya hogaya mera asghar
sheh ka sar jhuk gaya kuch mu se sunaaya na gaya
kaunsa ranj tha....
<<DIVIDER>>
jis tarha syede sajjad ko pahunchi eeza
koi bemaar bhi is tarha sataaya na gaya
kaunsa ranj tha....
<<DIVIDER>>
rehgaya ab bhi isi baat ka gham dil me 'nisar'
rauza shabbir ka aankho'n se lagaaya na gaya
kaunsa ranj tha....
